, there was a big mountain. On top of the mountain, there was a small house. In the house, a boy named Tom lived with his mom and dad. They were a happy family. Tom liked to play outside with his dog, Spot. One day, they went for a walk in the forest.
As they walked, Tom's mom said, "Be careful, Tom. Don't go too far away." Tom and Spot played and played. They ran and jumped all around the mountain. But then, Tom felt his tummy growl. He remembered what mom said about the cold air. So, they walked slowly back home.
When they got home, Tom started to feel cold. He looked at his hands and saw that he touched his hands with cold water. His mom gave him some water to help his feel better. Tom felt better. He learned not to go too far away from their house. The cold mountain had made their house warm, but now they had a warm place to live. And Tom and Spot lived happily ever after.
